== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Iron]] [[Hive]] is a massive, bulbous structure serving as a central hub for the [[Iron Legion]] fleet. These entities are composed of fused metal from various crashed starships and can reach sizes comparable to small moons or planets. Physically, they are described as pulsating masses of [[Iron|iron]] and organic matter that resemble hearts or even giant skulls. The [[Grand Hive]], a specific and significant version of these structures, features black [[Iron|iron]] and white skin with long, tusk-like spikes protruding from its hangar bays. Because they must allow fighters to enter and exit freely, [[Hives]] lack defensive shields, making them vulnerable to direct plasma fire. Functionally, [[Hives]] act as mobile bases and breeding grounds for the [[Legion]]. They can produce a vast number of soldiers known as [[Pawns]] and are capable of gestating an [[Iron King]]. While some [[Hives]] operate under the direction of a [[Bishop of the Iron Legion|Bishop]], those without such leadership act independently like wild animals, seeking out nearby planets to consume. The structures are highly active in galactic conflicts, often appearing near inhabited worlds to invade or snatch colonies. Though they can be destroyed by concentrated power, their core components and ritual elements are vital to the [[Legion]]'s ability to produce new leaders.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Constructed from the metal of crashed starships, the [[Iron]] [[Hive]] is a shifting environment that can be destabilized by large weapons and mapped using holograms. During an invasion of the location, the narrator fought through its interior to destroy the [[Iron King]], resulting in the total destruction of the [[Hive]]. This conflict was intense enough that the narrator's [[plasma cannons]] were warped following the battle. Beyond this specific site, an [[Iron]] [[Hive]] is also recognized as a type of entity or organization that one might serve as a Shepherd for.}}
